s.note: Halved boiled eggs filled with mustard and curry mayonnaise, smoked paprika and chives
s.how: Boil 4 eggs for 10 minutes, cool in iced water for 10 minutes, peel and halve. Mash the yolks with 3 tbsp mayonnaise, 1 tsp Dijon mustard, half a tsp curry powder and salt and pepper until smooth. Pipe or spoon back into the 8 whites, dust with smoked paprika and scatter with chopped chives.

s.note: Little French cheese puffs made with gruyère and a grating of nutmeg, served warm
s.how: Bring 125ml water, 50g butter and a pinch of salt to the boil, tip in 75g plain flour and beat over the heat for 2 minutes. Cool 5 minutes, then beat in 2 eggs one at a time and stir in 70g grated gruyère and a grating of nutmeg. Pipe 16 balls onto a lined tray, top with another 10g gruyère and bake at 200C for 25 minutes until puffed and deep golden.

m.note: Fish and prawns in a saffron, fennel and tomato broth with potatoes, garlic rouille and toasted baguette
m.how: Soften 1 sliced onion, 1 sliced fennel bulb, 3 garlic cloves and 1 tsp fennel seeds in 3 tbsp olive oil. Add a pinch of saffron, a strip of orange zest, a 400g tin of tomatoes, 1 litre fish stock and 400g sliced waxy potatoes and simmer for 20 minutes. Add 500g chunks of firm white fish for 4 minutes, then 300g peeled prawns for 3 minutes. Mix 4 tbsp mayonnaise with 1 crushed garlic clove and a pinch of cayenne for the rouille. Serve with toasted baguette and parsley.

w.note: Crisp pastry shell filled with a sharp baked lime and cream custard, finished with fresh zest
w.how: Line a 23cm tart tin with 1 sheet sweet shortcrust pastry, chill 20 minutes and blind bake at 180C for 20 minutes. Whisk 4 eggs with 150g caster sugar, the zest of 3 limes, 150ml lime juice and 150ml thickened cream. Pour into the shell and bake at 150C for 30 minutes until just set with a wobble. Cool and chill for 2 hours, then finish with more lime zest.

d.n: Betty smugglers' spiced rum and ginger
d.note: Dark rum over ice with a cinnamon and clove brown sugar syrup, fresh lime and ginger beer
d.how: Simmer 60g brown sugar, 60ml water, 1 cinnamon stick and 3 cloves for 3 minutes and cool. Fill 4 glasses with ice, add 60ml dark rum, 15ml spiced syrup and the juice of half a lime to each. Top with ginger beer and a lime wedge.
